title: Related Questions

answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 38302 Country: India Title: I go from Mumbai to a place in Kokan which is 250 km away but on the way I pass through my native place which is about 3 km from the place I visit Question: I go from Mumbai to a place in Kokan which is 250 km away but on the way I pass through my native place which is about 3 km from the place I visit but I do not stop at my native place home. Should I pray qasr at the place I visit? Answer ID: 38302 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 789/662/B=1433) As per the case mentioned above, you will have to offer qasr salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
